title: Allelic Imbalance and Chromothripsis Lead to Diversity in Japanese Tumor Genomes With Whole-Genome Duplication.
authors: Hatakeyama, Keiichi; Nagashima, Takeshi; Ohnami, Sumiko; Ohnami, Shumpei; Maruyama, Koji; Ohshima, Keiichi; Shimoda, Yuji; Naruoka, Akane; Kenmotsu, Hirotsugu; Urakami, Kenichi; Akiyama, Yasuto; Yamaguchi, Ken
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过全基因组测序分析日本肿瘤基因组的等位基因失衡与染色体碎裂，聚焦肿瘤基因组结构变异，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Whole-genome analyses have revealed that large-scale structural variations (SVs) such as whole-genome duplication (WGD) occur early in the development of many cancers. However, the diversity of chromosomal abnormalities within tumors before and after WGD remains poorly understood. Here, we analyzed various types of Japanese tumor genomes via whole-genome sequencing and examined the diversity of WGD by focusing on large SVs at the chromosomal level. WGD was detected in 52% of cases, while the frequency of chromothripsis (CT) was 20%. Although aneuploidy via deletion of chromosome arms was common in many cancers, in rare ovarian cancers, all chromosomes were near-haploidy before WGD. Minor allele analysis revealed that many non-mutated ohnolog genes drifted down chromosome arms after WGD and returned to normal ploidy, but only 17p, including TP53, which is also an ohnolog, underwent loss of heterozygosity due to arm deletion before WGD in most cancers. TP53 mutations were frequently detected in WGD and CT-positive tumors, and these SVs strongly correlated with homologous recombination deficiency scores. Furthermore, these tumors had many mutations that continued to generate neoantigens and resulted in worse survival outcomes. Diversity analysis of tumors with WGD will provide a new perspective on structural abnormalities in tumor genomes.
abstract_zh: 全基因组分析揭示，大规模结构变异（SVs），如全基因组重复（WGD），在许多癌症发展早期即已发生。然而，WGD前后肿瘤内染色体异常的多样性仍知之甚少。在此，我们通过全基因组测序分析了多种类型的日本肿瘤基因组，并聚焦于染色体水平上的大型结构变异，探讨了WGD的多样性。WGD在52%的病例中被检测到，而染色体碎裂（CT）的频率为20%。尽管通过染色体臂缺失导致的非整倍性在许多癌症中常见，但在罕见的卵巢癌中，所有染色体在WGD前接近单倍体状态。次要等位基因分析显示，许多未突变的ohnolog基因在WGD后沿染色体臂漂移并恢复至正常倍性，但仅17p（包括同为ohnolog的TP53）在大多数癌症中因臂缺失在WGD前发生杂合性丢失。TP53突变在WGD和CT阳性肿瘤中频繁检测到，这些结构变异与同源重组缺陷评分强烈相关。此外，这些肿瘤含有许多持续产生新抗原的突变，并导致较差的生存结局。对WGD肿瘤的多样性分析将为肿瘤基因组的结构异常提供新视角。
